#!/bin/bash
set -e

# ---- 1. Hash the password ON THE HOST ----
HASH=$(python3 - <<'EOF'
import base64, hashlib, os
salt = os.urandom(16)
key = hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac('sha512', os.environ['MASS_PASSWORD'].encode(), salt, 100000, 64)
print('@ByteArray(' + base64.b64encode(salt).decode() + ':' + base64.b64encode(key).decode() + ')')
EOF
)

# ---- 2. Stop qBittorrent, write username + hash under [Preferences], start it ----
pct exec 105 -- systemctl stop qbittorrent-nox.service
pct exec 105 -- sed -i '/^\[Preferences\]/a WebUI\\Username=admin' /var/lib/qbittorrent-nox/.config/qBittorrent/qBittorrent.conf
pct exec 105 -- sed -i "/^\[Preferences\]/a WebUI\\\\Password_PBKDF2=$HASH" /var/lib/qbittorrent-nox/.config/qBittorrent/qBittorrent.conf
pct exec 105 -- systemctl start qbittorrent-nox.service
sleep 3

# ---- 3. PROVE the login from the host ----
LOGIN=$(curl -s -d "username=admin&password=$MASS_PASSWORD" http://192.168.1.24:8080/api/v2/auth/login)
if [ "$LOGIN" != "Ok." ]; then
    echo "LOGIN FAILED: $LOGIN"
    exit 1
fi
echo "qBittorrent login: Ok."

# ---- 4. Update Radarr download client (id 1) with credentials ----
RADARR_KEY=$(pct exec 103 -- sh -c 'cat /var/lib/radarr/config.xml | sed -n "s:.*<ApiKey>\(.*\)</ApiKey>.*:\1:p" | head -n 1' | tr -d '\r\n')
RADARR_BODY=$(pct exec 103 -- sh -c 'curl -s -H "X-Api-Key: '"$RADARR_KEY"'" http://127.0.0.1:7878/api/v3/downloadclient/1' | tr -d '\r\n')
RADARR_UPDATED=$(echo "$RADARR_BODY" | python3 -c '
import json, sys
d = json.load(sys.stdin)
d["username"] = "admin"
d["password"] = "'"$MASS_PASSWORD"'"
d["priority"] = 1
print(json.dumps(d))
')
pct exec 103 -- sh -c 'curl -s --fail-with-body -X PUT -H "X-Api-Key: '"$RADARR_KEY"'" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '"'"''"$RADARR_UPDATED"''"'"' http://127.0.0.1:7878/api/v3/downloadclient/1'

# ---- 5. Test Radarr download client ----
pct exec 103 -- sh -c 'curl -s --fail-with-body -X POST -H "X-Api-Key: '"$RADARR_KEY"'" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{}" http://127.0.0.1:7878/api/v3/downloadclient/test/1'

# ---- 6. Update Sonarr download client (id 1) with credentials ----
SONARR_KEY=$(pct exec 104 -- sh -c 'cat /var/lib/sonarr/config.xml | sed -n "s:.*<ApiKey>\(.*\)</ApiKey>.*:\1:p" | head -n 1' | tr -d '\r\n')
SONARR_BODY=$(pct exec 104 -- sh -c 'curl -s -H "X-Api-Key: '"$SONARR_KEY"'" http://127.0.0.1:8989/api/v3/downloadclient/1' | tr -d '\r\n')
SONARR_UPDATED=$(echo "$SONARR_BODY" | python3 -c '
import json, sys
d = json.load(sys.stdin)
d["username"] = "admin"
d["password"] = "'"$MASS_PASSWORD"'"
d["priority"] = 1
print(json.dumps(d))
')
pct exec 104 -- sh -c 'curl -s --fail-with-body -X PUT -H "X-Api-Key: '"$SONARR_KEY"'" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '"'"''"$SONARR_UPDATED"''"'"' http://127.0.0.1:8989/api/v3/downloadclient/1'

# ---- 7. Test Sonarr download client ----
pct exec 104 -- sh -c 'curl -s --fail-with-body -X POST -H "X-Api-Key: '"$SONARR_KEY"'" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{}" http://127.0.0.1:8989/api/v3/downloadclient/test/1'

echo "ALL DONE"
